segments.text: Every month, someone manually types receipts into accounting software - copy-pasting vendor, amount, and VAT, line by line. I'm Shayan from SpielOS, and here's an ActivePieces flow that does the whole job in one upload.
You drop in an invoice. AI reads it and pulls out the vendor, the date, the total, and every line item - no fixed template, no special format.
Then a second AI step codes each line to the right GL account, writes the entry to your ledger, archives the original file to Drive, and gives you a clean summary.

Quick note on the ledger step: here it's an ActivePieces table standing in for the real thing. In a client build this is Xero, QuickBooks, or Sage - same fields, just wired to your actual accounting tool.
Let's run it for real. Here's the form - I'll upload an actual invoice.
In production that file could land from inbound email, a Google Sheet, or any connected app. I hit submit and the AI takes over.
It's reading the invoice now - extracting the vendor, the line items, the amounts - then coding each line to its account. Normally about thirty seconds; I've sped it up here.
And there it is: vendor, total, VAT, every line coded to the right GL account, logged to the ledger and archived to Drive.
One upload. Full capture and coding. No manual data entry, nothing copy-pasted into accounting software.
Want a workflow like this for your books? Shoot me a DM - thanks for watching.
